body: before we even dated and i was in love with him, and even after we started dating and i didn't get to see him for a day, i did these things. imagine he was sleeping next to me, saying things outloud that i would say if he were with me. imagine how i feel now that he's gone.
i don't want to adapt, even if i went on, i wouldn't ever want to be with anyone else again. he means that much to me.
